# Riviera Joyas

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store selling watches such as Seiko, Orient, Citizen, Tissot and Casio, and gold, silver and plated jewelry, with prices in USD. Delivers in Montevideo and the interior by UES and offers pickup points in two Montevideo shopping centers.
